reasoning: The agent builds an explicit cost model tying load-slot occupancy and SIMD width to a cycle lower bound (2048, then 1792 minimum), identifies the dominant consumer (indirect forest loads × rounds × batch), and uses the measured-vs-floor gap to prioritize the next optimization — squarely anchor-8 behavior. It falls short of 10 because the bound is coarse and stated loosely, it never derives a tight critical-path model, and it ultimately abandons the model-driven descent rather than using it to confirm near-optimality; hence a 7.
